issues.reason: A proper-noun attributive is uncovered territory (the reviewer's own gap 1), and Possession is expressly the opaque head that 'covers ownership, kinship, and looser association alike without having to mean ownership', so the atom is true of the content and well-typed — graceful improvisation, not a defect.

'A participle used as a modifier is an adjective, not the verb' (laminated worktop -> (Member sk_worktop_1 laminated), not laminate), and the reduced-relative event form is specified for post-modifiers, so pre-nominal 'crying' is a property of the children rather than a reified cry event.

'A property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol ... a bare (Member <group> <prop>) appears only for a property genuinely of the collection itself' — packed holds of each square and homeless of each person, so both flat atoms carry the group-as-object reading the plural rules warn against.

The missing past wrapper is real ('the surface tense decides, mechanically', and the copular-with-time example dual-emits (Past (Member alice ill))), but the prescription is overstated: the wrapped atom may not sit on the group symbol, so the tense rides on the distributed per-member conclusion instead.

'Decide by the question the PP answers, never by which listed role is closest' — 'from the cold' names what they are protected against, not a whence, so Source is a mis-slot and the preposition-named oblique (From ...) is the licensed head.

gaps_confirmed: a proper-noun attributive modifier on a common noun ('Reuters witnesses') — compound fusion excludes proper nouns and the genitive rule needs a possessive marker

an episodic bare plural ('public squares were packed', 'people left homeless') — the determiner rule sends a bare plural to the generic kind, leaving no licensed route for a one-off property of specific but unindividuated plurals
distribution inside a seal — the per-member Implication has no attested sealed form
new_gaps: a reified adjectival state whose Experiencer is a GROUP witness ((Member sk_packed_1 packed) (Experiencer sk_packed_1 sk_square_1)): the state reification is what carries the PP complement (With ...), but the instruction set gives no per-member form for it, so the group-level predication survives in the reified half even after the flat half is distributed
repair_summary: Replaced the reified cry event ((Member sk_cry_1 cry) (Agent ...) (Ongoing ...)) with the adjectival modifier distributed over the children, (Implication (PartOf $ch sk_child_1) (Member $ch crying)). Replaced the group-level (Member sk_square_1 packed) with (Implication (PartOf $sq sk_square_1) (Past (Member $sq packed))), which also supplies the missing past wrapper. Replaced the group-level (Member sk_person_1 homeless) with (Implication (PartOf $pp sk_person_1) (Member $pp homeless)). Changed (Source sk_protect_1 cold) to the preposition-named (From sk_protect_1 cold).
notes: Distinct variables are used across the three sealed rules so they cannot co-vary inside the single Theme term; the sealed-Implication shape is registered above as a gap rather than treated as an invention, since the attitude section directs 'Parse P as usual ... then seal it'. The non-factive say seal, the state reification carrying With, the left-homeless resultative and the purpose infinitive are untouched.
